description.value: Wildlight Kitchen + Bar is a MICHELIN Guide Recommended modern West Coast restaurant at UBC's Lelǝm Village, nestled between the University Endowment Lands and Pacific Spirit Park on Musqueam Nation territory. Chef Warren Chow — recipient of Michelin's inaugural Vancouver Young Chef Award in 2023 — leads an all-day menu built around ethically sourced Pacific seafood, produce from UBC Farm, and locally raised meats, paired with BC wines and handcrafted cocktails. A warmly styled dining room and enclosed glass year-round atrium make it a notable stop for cyclists riding the UBC loop or Point Grey routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active with a 2026 copyright and detailed menu/contact pages, confirming the business is open. Takeout is explicitly advertised ('Takeout Now Available — Pick a time and place your order online'), and the menu uses V/VE/GF labels throughout, confirming vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those remain null; the phone number 604-915-0722 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags.
